description: Compare selected genome protein sets with BV-BRC GenomeComparison; retain original matches, reported first-HSP measurements and explicit comparison populations.
instructions:
Compare the supplied protein sets with BV-BRC GenomeComparison to examine shared protein matches and differences between selected genomes. Supply the original genome_ids, Workspace protein FASTA paths in user_genomes, and Workspace feature_group paths in user_feature_groups as applicable. Preserve their order and repeated occurrences. reference_genome_index is one-based in the concatenation of those three arrays, in that order. Supply an explicit index when its identity must be established; an omitted option does not prove that a declared default was used. Supply output_path and output_file explicitly. min_ident, min_seq_cov, min_positives and max_e_val are native application parameters; preserve the selected values. Submitted parameters, observed effective parameters and later score-calculation parameters are distinct.

Commission the existing launch episode with the requested comparison, scope and resource constraints. Its API child uses api.bvbrc_appservice.prepare to validate the chosen definition, original parameters, explicit input bindings and Workspace destination without submission. Select required Workspace creation and upload operations separately. submit makes the selected AppService.start_app2 request and retains the response and original task identity. Monitoring uses the API resource's generic monitoring task with selected query_tasks, stdout or stderr observations. Retain native states, timing and logs. The episode chooses any further observation or repair; there is no automatic retry or polling schedule.

Commission the existing results episode to acquire the original task's selected artifacts. task_info(job_result_id) gives the job-result UUID; workspace_metadata obtains its actual object. Acquire the selected manifest through its capability, then select exact manifest_member output indices for scientific files. Preserve complete bytes, task associations and acquisition completeness. A basename, folder listing, HTML page or stable UUID does not establish a numerical format or immutable producing-run bytes.

Select bvbrc_proteome version 1 for the requested projection. Its parameters specify analysis_id, native_documents, primary_document_id, supplied_data_evidence and calculation_parameters. Select the actual proteome_native_projection role and genome_comparison_json_v1 or genome_comparison_tsv_v1 format, with null version and mode. These are GenomeComparison's custom formats, not NCBI BLAST JSON. Select each document's actual source and artifact; the primary document is explicit. Supply representation correspondence before treating JSON and TSV as interchangeable observations.

Supply original parameter, FASTA and feature/genome/sequence metadata evidence explicitly when requested calculations need it. Keep original input slots, duplicate occurrences, sequence identities and metadata joins distinct. Current database records do not prove the bytes staged in an earlier job. Missing exact executed-input counts remain missing; do not infer a no-match fraction from returned rows alone. Retained input files are not proof they were executed.

The current numerical path preserves reported first-HSP identity, the legacy subject-endpoint-difference measurement, native hit categories, explicit bound occurrence counts and selected-population summaries. It does not reconstruct discarded HSPs or treat endpoint differences as full alignment coverage. Native measurements, supplied metadata, populated sheet and calculated components are retained separately. Calculators consume the saved sheet and explicit thresholds; changing thresholds does not rerun the service or rewrite historical results. Native match categories are categories, not calibrated annotation probabilities.

Request only the needed measurement, ratio, population, association, selection, requirements, qualifications and request_status fields using the provider's finite requested-form selectors. Their eight typed return families carry the requested original facts to the receiving episode. Preserve measured zero, unavailable, invalid, incompatible and partial results separately. Full native artifacts and sheets remain retained for later use; they are not copied into the parent's prompt. This API contract does not establish a live service run or local/HPC deployment.
